title: If the Bible is true…
paragraphs:
If the Bible is true…
eternity is longer than your entire life.

This life is a breath.
Eternity never ends.
The real question isn't how long you'll live.
We spend most of our life worrying about money, jobs, and reputation.

But if the Bible is true…
eternity is longer than your entire life.

If eternity is real…
why do most people live like this life is all there is?
